description:
Six months have passed since the polar opposite classmates Miyu Suzuki and Yuusuke Tani started dating. Through spending time together along with their friends from school, the two have been happier than ever. As the year nears its end, the new couple plans to celebrate Christmas and the New Year together, making memories for years to come.

Meanwhile, Miyu and Yuusuke's friends Shuuji Taira and Kentarou Yamada are puzzled by their own situations. Due to his bad experiences in middle school, Taira still overthinks everything around him, especially after his classmate Shino Azuma began giving him more attention. Simultaneously, the usually energetic and outspoken Yamada finds it difficult to find the perfect time to confess his feelings to his shy schoolmate Natsumi Nishi. Despite everyone's differences, they continue enjoying their adolescence together and find their own ways to turn the winter break into a cherished memory.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

She has been active as a voice actor since 2010, debuting in the anime Occult Academy voicing the character Akari Okamoto, while debuting as a singer-songwriter in December 2015.

Inori was born in Tokyo, where she began watching anime in kindergarten. She first became aware of voice acting when, after watching a stage play adaptation of an anime, she read the stage pamphlet and asked her parents about a person mentioned in it. She found out that she wanted to become a voice actor at the age of six, and in elementary school, she listed voice acting as her desired future career. 

In middle school, Inori joined her school's tennis and theater clubs; however, she quit the theater club due to feeling too embarrassed when appearing on stage. Around the same time, her mother found a magazine advertising a voice-acting audition, which she participated in and won.

Koyasu has taken over many of [Kaneto Shiozawa](https://anilist.co/staff/95424/)’s roles after Shiozawa’s passing.

node.body:
Olha, eu já esperava uma animação de peso vindo da T-Rex – o estúdio já provou seu valor no nicho diversas vezes e eu confiava que viria coisa boa. Mas, mesmo com essa expectativa positiva lá no alto, fui surpreendido por algo que não estava nos meus cálculos: um casting de seiyuus (dubladores) simplesmente divino. Slk, a entonação, os suspiros, a respiração ofegante e a química no meu ouvido até balanço, elevaram a parada para um patamar que pouquíssimos OVAs alcançam. Não é só "gemer no microfone"; há uma entrega dramática genuína que casa perfeitamente com as expressões faciais dos personagens. Resultado? Essa adaptação já garantiu uma vaga cativa no meu Top 10 hentai da vida, e olha que a concorrência é brutal.

Do início ao fim, foram cerca de 30 minutos de pura imersão, com o sexo escancarado como foco, mas sem perder a fluidez narrativa. Diferente de muitas adaptações que picotam momentos-chave do mangá, aqui senti que o estúdio respeitou o material original na medida certa, entregando cenas longas, bem coreografadas e com uma intensidade crescente. Agora é esperar ansiosamente pela adaptação da próxima parte – e torço para que venha logo, sem enrolação.

Um dos maiores medos da comunidade é a famigerada queda de qualidade gráfica ou de direção do primeiro para o segundo EP. Normalmente, quando dividem uma obra em dois episódios, o orçamento do piloto é alto e o restante acaba sendo feito nas coxas. Porém, nesse caso, a T-Rex mandou bem demais – a régua permaneceu altíssima em ambos os episódios. Os traços continuam firmes, o sombreamento impecável e a fluidez dos movimentos não sofreu nenhum degrau. Talvez as escolhas de desenvolvimento do plot tenham sido um pouco "rushadas" (aceleradas) em certas transições, com algumas conexões emocionais pulando etapas para chegar logo à cena quente. Mas, e aqui vai um "mas" gigante, isso não tirou nem um pouco da emoção que os dois EPs proporcionaram. A energia é tão contagiante que você releva a pressa narrativa pela qualidade absurda do que está sendo mostrado. Dito isso, com todas as letras: isso é puro cinema. Se o cinema tradicional tivesse 1% da ousadia e da entrega visual que esse OVA tem, a indústria cinematográfica seria outro patamar.

Falando em gênero, esse estilo de hentai "Vanilla" me agrada profundamente. É leve, fofo, romântico e emocionante. A conexão entre os personagens vai além da luxúria; há um cuidado, um carinho e um respeito mútuo que fazem qualquer um com um mínimo de sensibilidade torcer pelo casal. E aqui vai meu apelo sincero aos roteiristas e produtores: pelo amor de tudo que é sagrado, parem com esse vício obsessivo em Netorare (NTR). O mercado está saturado de traições, humilhações e finais amargos. Vocês têm um filão de ouro nas mãos com produções assim, que apostam no amor genuíno e na química verdadeira. Por favor, nos presenteiem mais com histórias fofas e de amor verdadeiro como essa! O público precisa de cura, não de traumas extras.

Agora, preciso dedicar um parágrafo exclusivo para aquilo que, tecnicamente, é a obra-prima dentro da obra-prima: a animação do quadril e da bunda. Puta que pariu, que movimentação divina! A equipe de animação claramente estudou física aplicada e cinemática corporal. Não é um simples sobe e desce robótico; há um delay natural da carne, uma rotação pélvica calculada, uma ondulação que respeita a inércia e o peso dos corpos. A câmera acompanha os ângulos com precisão cirúrgica, valorizando cada curva e cada impacto. É fluido, pesado e etéreo ao mesmo tempo – uma coreografia visual que poucos estúdios OVA ousam tentar, pois exige um orçamento e um talento que são raríssimos. Dá para ver os quadros-chave sendo esticados na pancada certa, criando um impacto visual que fica gravado na retina.

Por fim, fazer uma avaliação crítica de hentai é um desafio filosófico e biológico. Como ser imparcial quando seu cérebro de baixo está no comando total da nave? A testosterona e a dopamina interferem diretamente na percepção crítica. Você começa a avaliar a direção de arte, mas seus olhos já estão vidrados na fluidez dos movimentos; você tenta prestar atenção na trilha sonora, mas seus ouvidos já estão sintonizados em outra frequência. É um exercício de autocontrole tentar desligar o "modo tesão" para ligar o "modo crítico". Talvez a verdadeira nota de um hentai não esteja na objetividade, mas na capacidade dele de fazer você querer reassistir com os dois cérebros – um para apreciar a arte, e o outro, bem... para apreciar a arte também. E esse OVA conseguiu essa proeza. Nota máxima, expectativa lá no alto para a adaptação da próxima parte (e espero que venha logo, sem delays). Que venha o EP 3 para coroar essa trilogia perfeita!"

node.description: __Yoshiyuki Okamura__, also known as **Buronson** (武論尊) or **Sho Fumimura** (史村 翔, Fumimura Shō), is a Japanese manga writer most known by his famous work Hokuto no Ken, known in English as Fist of the North Star.  He graduated from the Japanese Air Force Training School in 1967 and served as an Air Force radar mechanic. In 1969 he discharged from the Japanese Navy and was soon hired by Hiroshi Motomiya as a manga assistant. He started his manga writing career when he wrote the script of Pink Punch: Miyabi in 1972, drawn by Goro Sakai. In 1975 Buronson wrote his first big hit The Doberman Detective, drawn by Shinji Hiramatsu. The famous Hokuto no Ken made its debute as Buronson's greatest hit in 1983, drawn by Tetsuo Hara. In 1989 his story Ourou was released as a manga serialized in Animal Magazine, drawn by Kentarou Miura, and in 1990 a sequel entitled Ourou Den was released by the same manga artist. Buronson also collaborated with the manga artist Ryoichi Ikegami in many works as Strain (manga) , Human (manga) and the famous Sanctuary (manga). Among his other major works are The Phantom Gang, with art by Kaoru Shintani.    Buronson was mainly influenced by movies such as Bruce Lee's, and Mad Max.    The nickname Buronson is a tribute to the American actor Charles Bronson, whose way of growing the mustache was imitated by Yoshiyuki Okamura too.

[Official website](http://www.haratetsuo.com/)

After graduating from Hongou Senior High School, he became an assistant to comic book artist Yoshihiro Takahashi. Hara's own professional comic artist career began in 1982 with the publication of his first work, "Mad Fighter". He won the first prize of the 33rd "Fresh Jump" award for "Super Challenger". His Weekly Shonen Jump debut was "Iron Don Quixote". His distinctive art in "Hokuto no Ken" began in 1983; it was his first major work.

node.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Soul Realm:__ Red

After dying at the hands of the Sage Emperor, Nie Li wakes up back in his thirteen year old body. Given a second chance to save his loved ones, he is determined to stop Sacred Family from betraying Glory City, and causing the attack that not only destroyed his home but killed all his friends and family.

Nie Li is a member of the Heavenly Marks Family, a declining and weak aristocratic family. His initial talent is considered by others to be poor and is lacking in culture and social position. However, he retains all the knowledge he gathered while roaming the Divine Continent in his past life. Using that, he plans to cultivate himself to far greater heights in this life and defeat the enemies he makes along the way. He has a very calm and determined personality. Though his appearance is that of a thirteen year old, he truly has the mind of someone far older and more experienced. (Due to the rebirth).

__Abilities and Equipment:__
~!
- __Secret Soul Techniques:__ Divine Stream

- __Temporal Demon Spirit Book:__ An attack which pierces his enemies with a beam of light

- __Shadow Devil Form:__ A state where Nie Li becomes completely invisible and undetectable but can not affect the world around him, as he increases his level of cultivation to the higher stages, he can perform this ability for longer lengths of time with a higher concealment ability so he can hide from stronger foes as the story progresses. He has 2 other abilities from his shadow devil form, being Arm sickle and fist mutation. Fist mutation allows Nie Li to use the power of law in his fist for different attack types.

- __Fanged Panda Form:__ Thunder Strike which is the basic attack with a large force behind it. Gravity Field which controls the gravity in a 5 metre radius around himself and Yin Yang Blast which is a long range attack that shoots two energy balls which explode with a radius of damage of 10 meters, the longer he charges this attack, the more power he can get out of it, the maximum power he can get out of the attack is 10x the original power.

In addition to these abilities, he also has the Demon Blood Sacrifice which strengthened Nie Li's cultivation and physique with that of a Primordial Bloodline Demon Beast as to withstand the cultivation techniques he uses.
!~

__Race:__ Human
__Soul Realm:__ Green

One of the students in the fighter apprentice class with Nie Li. She is a member of the noble Winged Dragon family. One of the main motivations behind her strong determination in training is her wish to escape from an arranged marriage between her and the Sacred Family's Shen Fei, who she despise and hate.

She is described as having shoulder length black hair and a slim figure The Manhua varies from this by showing her with long brownish orange hair. She is a cold and anti-social beauty. Her personality is that of a serious student, unyielding woman with a strong determination. She is very grateful to Nie Li for giving her the ability to oppose her arranged marriage with her newfound powers and for curing her of the Arctic disease before the worst happened. She was the first woman to start loving Nie Li in his rebirth life.

__Abilities and Equipment:__
~!
- __Heavenly Lightning Sparrow:__ She can throw lightning bolts at will and blind her enemies at her command.

- __Divine Scarlet Thunderbird:__ Her spirit form she can use to kill her enemies, like Nie Li's fanged panda and shadow devil.

-__Lightning Gale Sword:__ After the death of her spirit and became replaced by one of the dragon bloodline, she had her Heavenly Lightning Sparrow demon spirit refined into a sword that she can brandish to kill her foes.

She is in possession of a page from the Temporal Demon Spirit Book which was sealed inside a tattoo on her by her grandfather.

Sumire entered the entertainment industry at the age of 9, when she was scouted by Space Craft's junior talent division. In 2009, she landed her first regular radio gig as host of Web Raji@Dengeki Bunko, and in 2011, she transferred to animation division of Space Craft due her interest in becoming a voice actress. On March 12, 2016, Sumire received the Best Rookie Actress award in the 10th Seiyuu Awards. She has also been a member of the seiyuu unit ".lady." since 2014.

Sumire is fluent in Russian and loves the Soviet culture, which she became interested in after hearing the State Anthem of the USSR in her first year of high school. In April 2010, Sumire entered the Faculty of Foreign Studies at Sophia University, and she majored in the Russian language there.

Sumire is interested in history and war figurines, particularly Russian/Soviet history, the Showa era, and likes the book Romance of the Three Kingdoms. She also has had a strong interest in games, anime and manga ever since she was a child. Her other interests consists of photography, lolita fashion-- she works as a lolita model-- and drawing, which she is quite good at. She also loves rock and heavy metal; her favorite bands are Metallica, Judas Priest, Black Sabbath, Dragonforce, and Kinniku Shoujo Tai. Additionally, Sumire is very good friends with fellow seiyuu [Sachika Misawa](https://anilist.co/staff/102337/Sachika-Misawa), who has called Sumire "her waifu".
